CustomField.description: This field will calculate the age in number of days of an opportunity based on the following conditions: 1.) Lost, and Dead opportunities will be calculated based on the time transpired from Create Date to Date Lost or Date Dead respectively and if available 2.) Stages 5, 6, and 7 that have been sent to NCSP will be calculated based on the time transpired from Create Date to Sent to NCSP Date. 3.) For Stage 6 or 7 that were not sent to NCSP, the calculation will be from the Create Date to the Stage 6 Entered Date, unless Stage 6 was skipped and then it will be calculated based on the Create Date to the Stage 7 Entered Date. 4.) The remaining opportunities that don't meet these conditions (including all open opportunities) will be calculated by Create Date to Today's Date.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost') && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Lost__c)), Date_Lost__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Dead') && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Dead__c)), Date_Dead__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), IF(((ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in')) || (ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup')) || (ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed'))) && NOT(ISBLANK(Sent_to_NCSP_Date__c)), Sent_to_NCSP_Date__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), IF(((ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup')) || (ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed'))) && ISBLANK(Sent_to_NCSP_Date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(IM_Stage_6_Entered_Date__c)), IM_Stage_6_Entered_Date__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), IF(((ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup')) || (ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed'))) && ISBLANK(Sent_to_NCSP_Date__c) && ISBLANK(IM_Stage_6_Entered_Date__c), IM_Stage_7_Entered_Date__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), Now()-CreatedDate )))))
CustomField.label: Opportunity Age
